confirmed.claim: One corrupt line in defect-queue.jsonl makes the ENTIRE queue read as empty, silently and permanently: _queue_rows() (lines 206-213) parses every line inside a single try and catches (OSError, ValueError) — json.JSONDecodeError subclasses ValueError — returning [] on the first bad line. Mechanism reproduced: a list-comprehension parse of one truncated trailing line raises JSONDecodeError and yields [].

From then on: drive() returns 'queue-empty' while open defects exist; beat_async() reports 'nothing-to-do'; review_and_queue()'s dedup check (line 298) sees an empty queue and appends duplicate rows that are equally invisible. The loop looks healthy ('nothing to do') indefinitely; no alert ever fires; the file never heals because reads fail on the same line forever.
